name: empty
description: A server with no devices the credential can see, which is what a fresh install or an organisation filter matching nothing looks like. Open-AudIT answers 200 with an empty data array rather than an error, so the run must report zero assets and exit cleanly instead of treating the empty collection as a failure. An empty FIRST page with the default status filter applied is ambiguous -- it is also what a server version that fails to parse notin(deleted,lost,retired) as an operator answers, because the literal equality matches nothing -- so the walk retries exactly once without the server-side filter (excluding retired devices client-side instead) before concluding the estate is empty. Asserts both requests, the retry log line, and that no per-device detail request is attempted.

log_contains: open-audit: no devices matched the status filter; retrying without it and excluding retired devices client-side
